Data:Commit.ill.s.disciplines.thescar.js.label: The Scar
Data:Commit.ill.s.disciplines.thescar.js.startdescription: The Mansus is the fortress of dream where the true Hours rule, and Nowhere is the scar beneath it where the Nowhere Hours lair. Without the Hours above, that scar would be an open wound. So the Bright Arts teach us.
Data:Commit.ill.s.disciplines.thescar.js.desc: The Mansus is the fortress of dream where the true Hours rule, and Nowhere is the scar beneath it where the Nowhere Hours lair. Without the Hours above, that scar would be an open wound. So the Bright Arts teach us.

Data:Commit.ill.s.edictsmartial.json.label: Understanding Creates Conflict
Data:Commit.ill.s.edictsmartial.json.startdescription: When we name our differences, we learn our enemies. Where there are no names, there are no enemies. This is a matter of the Illumination Wisdom.
Data:Commit.ill.s.edictsmartial.json.desc: When we name our differences, we learn our enemies. Where there are no names, there are no enemies.

Data:Commit.ill.s.ericapaean.json.label: The King and the Key
Data:Commit.ill.s.ericapaean.json.startdescription:
There is a story told by students of light: that a great and golden King held the only key to his deepest prison cell. One day he asked his minister to make eight copies, and distribute them among the people. 'But Sire,' the minister said, 'if a rebel contrives to enter our palace, might they not release their confederates?'

'They might,' answered the King. 'But all kingdoms fall, and one day I might myself seek release from that cell.'
Data:Commit.ill.s.ericapaean.json.desc:
A great and golden King held the only key to his deepest prison cell. One day he asked his minister to make eight copies, and distribute them among the people. 'But Sire,' the minister said, 'if a rebel contrives to enter our palace, might they not release their confederates?'

'They might,' answered the King. 'But all kingdoms fall, and one day I might myself seek release from that cell.'

Data:Commit.ill.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.label: The White Flower's Paradox
Data:Commit.ill.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.startdescription: A paradox of Illumination: light reveals, light blinds. This is the lesson of the White Flower of the Watchman's Tree: even the most dangerous of knowledge is no danger at all when it is forgotten.
Data:Commit.ill.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.desc: Light reveals, light blinds. This is the lesson of the White Flower of the Watchman's Tree: even the most dangerous of knowledge is no danger at all when it is forgotten.

Data:Commit.ill.s.meniscatereflections.j.label: What Could Be
Data:Commit.ill.s.meniscatereflections.j.startdescription: Dream of a city of perfect balance. There can be no perfect balance outside dream. Meditate on the Hour named Meniscate, whose light is cast in dreams but we see even in the Wake. Build the City in the heart of her domain, in the House of the Moon. Be Illuminated.
Data:Commit.ill.s.meniscatereflections.j.desc: Dream of a city of perfect balance. There can be no perfect balance outside dream. Meditate on the Hour named Meniscate, whose light in dreams is perfect balance. Build the City in the heart of her domain, in the House of the Moon.

Data:Commit.ill.s.preliminalmeter.json.label: Of Keys
Data:Commit.ill.s.preliminalmeter.json.startdescription:
One of us passed the Summit. One may not.
Two of us sought the Lantern. Two chose flight.
The seventh rarely named, but not forgot.

 This is Illumination.
Data:Commit.ill.s.preliminalmeter.json.desc:
One of us passed the Summit. One may not.
Two of us sought the Lantern. Two chose flight.
The seventh rarely named, but not forgot.

Data:Commit.ill.s.purifications.exaltati.label: The Hours
Data:Commit.ill.s.purifications.exaltati.startdescription: Never underestimate the Hour named Meniscate. Foolish adepts deride her as an Hour of vanity. What do they think defines the Hours? Light purifies; light exalts.
Data:Commit.ill.s.purifications.exaltati.desc: Never underestimate the Hour named Meniscate. Foolish adepts deride as an Hour of vanity. What do they think defines the Hours?

Data:Commit.ill.s.pyroglyphics.json.label: Birth in Fire
Data:Commit.ill.s.pyroglyphics.json.startdescription: Fire was the first understanding. The Hour named Moth learnt that even before the Watchman brought light. This is Illumination.
Data:Commit.ill.s.pyroglyphics.json.desc: Fire was the first understanding. The Hour named Moth learnt that even before the Watchman brought light.

Data:Commit.ill.s.raggedcrossroads.json.label: Tomorrow's Light
Data:Commit.ill.s.raggedcrossroads.json.startdescription: Every regret is a lesson. We cannot change what is past, but neither should we wish to. Regret is Illumination.
Data:Commit.ill.s.raggedcrossroads.json.desc: Every regret is a lesson. We cannot change what is past, but neither should we wish to.

Data:Commit.ill.s.sacrasolisinvicti.json.label: A Light Within
Data:Commit.ill.s.sacrasolisinvicti.json.startdescription: The New King's light is uncertain. The Received Version of the Book of Suns tells that the Sun-in-Splendour will never return. If the King claims otherwise, he leads us astray. We should seek answers in Illumination.
Data:Commit.ill.s.sacrasolisinvicti.json.desc: The New King's light is uncertain. The Received Version of the Book of Suns tells that the Sun-in-Splendour will never return. If the King claims otherwise, he leads us astray.

Data:Commit.ill.s.transformations.libera.label: From Light
Data:Commit.ill.s.transformations.libera.startdescription: If even the Sun's division was a plan... then once we complete that plan, we'll bring the Second Dawn, and unite the sun. It won't be easy, but what great work ever is? Illumination might show the way.
Data:Commit.ill.s.transformations.libera.desc: If even the Sun's division was a plan... then once we complete that plan, we'll bring the Second Dawn, and unite the sun. It won't be easy, but what great work ever is?

Data:Commit.ill.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.label: From Light
Data:Commit.ill.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.startdescription: Our dreams are shadows cast by the Watchman's light. So we perceive him even in our shadow. This is Illumination.
Data:Commit.ill.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.desc: Our dreams are shadows cast by the Watchman's light. So we perceive him even in our shadow.

Data:Commit.ith.s.anbary.lapidary.json.label: Amber
Data:Commit.ith.s.anbary.lapidary.json.startdescription: The Bright Arts speak of a shining City Unbuilt. One day, we might build it like a jewel in the sea… with a foundation-stone of amber.  This would be a great work of Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.anbary.lapidary.json.desc: The Bright Arts speak of a shining City Unbuilt. One day, we might build it like a jewel in the sea… with a foundation-stone of amber.

Data:Commit.ith.s.bells.brazieries.json.label: The Chime
Data:Commit.ith.s.bells.brazieries.json.startdescription: In the right mortal's hand, the right tool can become the weapon that ends a war. This is a high purpose of Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.bells.brazieries.json.desc: In the right mortal's hand, the right tool can become the weapon that ends a war.

Data:Commit.ith.s.fucine.json.label: The Queen's Weapon
Data:Commit.ith.s.fucine.json.startdescription: There is a story known to smiths: of a Queen whose realm was invaded by a great army. When she learnt that there were nine invaders for every defender, she ordered her army to surrender its swords. Night and day her smiths laboured to melt down the swords to bronze, while her generals threatened mutiny and the enemy advanced unhindered. They used the bronze to cast a Bell, but each time the Bell was rung, it cracked and had to be recast. At last on the night before the invaders reached the city, the Queen surrendered her crown to the casting. When at dawn the smiths rang the Bell, it cracked the moon like an egg and drove the sun from the sky. The invaders fled. But the Queen without a crown was no longer any queen at all.
Data:Commit.ith.s.fucine.json.desc: A Queen's realm was invaded by a great army. When she learnt that there were nine invaders for every defender, she ordered her army to surrender its swords. At last on the night before the invaders reached the city, the Queen surrendered her crown to the casting. When at dawn the smiths rang the Bell, it cracked the moon like an egg and drove the sun from the sky. The invaders fled. But the Queen without a crown was no longer any queen at all.

Data:Commit.ith.s.glassblowing.vesselcra.label: Glass, the Egg
Data:Commit.ith.s.glassblowing.vesselcra.startdescription: The highest purpose of a glass vessel: to show clearly perfectly what would otherwise be hidden within. Perhaps, Ithastry suggests, this was the first purpose of the first Hour, and only in that first moment could there be perfect clarity.
Data:Commit.ith.s.glassblowing.vesselcra.desc: The highest purpose of a glass vessel: to show clearly perfectly what would otherwise be hidden within. Perhaps this was the first purpose of the first Hour, and only in that first moment could there be perfect clarity.

Data:Commit.ith.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.label: The Red Flower's Lesson
Data:Commit.ith.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.startdescription: A lesson from Ithastry: fire reveals, smoke conceals. This is the lesson of the Red Flower of the Watchman's Tree: even the most dangerous of knowledge is no danger at all when it is given to the fire.
Data:Commit.ith.s.glaziery.lightsmithing.desc: Fire reveals, smoke conceals. This is the lesson of the Red Flower of the Watchman's Tree: even the most dangerous of knowledge is no danger at all when it is given to the fire.

Data:Commit.ith.s.henavek.json.label: The Stars
Data:Commit.ith.s.henavek.json.startdescription: A smiths' proverb in Brancrug: 'What starts in the sky, ends in the earth.' A story goes with it, that the village smith's anvil in the time of the Dewulfs was hatched from a meteor stone, and so every plough in the village knows something of the stars. Not many remember the story, but everyone remembers the proverb. It would probably count as Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.henavek.json.desc: A smiths' proverb in Brancrug: 'What starts in the sky, ends in the earth.' A story goes with it, that the village smith's anvil in the time of the Dewulfs was hatched from a meteor stone, and so every plough in the village knows something of the stars. Not many remember the story, but everyone remembers the proverb.

Data:Commit.ith.s.inks.revelation.json.label: Truths that Will Be
Data:Commit.ith.s.inks.revelation.json.startdescription: The inks called encaustum terminale are permitted only to the Librarians of the Watchman's Tree. Those inks can be used to reveal truths - even truths too great for daylight. Perhaps, then, daylight is not bright enough; perhaps we must find a way to kindle a light bright enough to reveal those greater truths. This would be a matter for Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.inks.revelation.json.desc: The inks called encaustum terminale are permitted only to the Librarians of the Watchman's Tree. Those inks can be used to reveal truths - even truths too great for daylight. Perhaps, then, daylight is not bright enough; perhaps we must find a way to kindle a light bright enough to reveal those greater truths.

Data:Commit.ith.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.label: Of Clocks
Data:Commit.ith.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.startdescription: The clocksmith's first duty: when the time comes, the device should speak its purpose. Since the Sun was sundered, Noon is not as it was. Perhaps, if we found the true hour of Noon, we'd know how the Sun might return. Ithastry might give us that answer.
Data:Commit.ith.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.desc: The clocksmith's first duty: when the time comes, the device should speak its purpose. Since the Sun was sundered, Noon is not as it was. Perhaps, if we found the true hour of Noon, we'd know how the Sun might return.

Data:Commit.ith.s.mandaic.json.label: The Chandler's Tale
Data:Commit.ith.s.mandaic.json.startdescription: There is a story known to candle-makers: of a guild-master who made a wager with a master of the potter's guild. The potter's oldest cup (she said) was older far than the chandler's oldest candle. However often one drinks from a cup, it can always be refilled. So they brought their witnesses to the judging on the appointed day, and the potter's witness brought a cup he had used for seventy years until its shattering. But the chandler's witness brought a candle seventy-seven years old: every month, the chandler had bought the old stumps, returned their matter to the vat, and used them in his wares, so that each newest candle was also the oldest. Ithastry teaches us: there's always a way.
Data:Commit.ith.s.mandaic.json.desc: A master candle-maker made a wager with a master of the potter's guild. The potter's oldest cup (she said) was older far than the chandler's oldest candle. However often one drinks from a cup, it can always be refilled. So they brought their witnesses to the judging on the appointed day, and the potter's witness brought a cup he had used for seventy years until its shattering. But the chandler's witness brought a candle seventy-seven years old: every month, the chandler had bought the old stumps, returned their matter to the vat, and used them in his wares, so that each newest candle was also the oldest. Perhaps there's always a way.

Data:Commit.ith.s.preliminalmeter.json.label: Of Swords
Data:Commit.ith.s.preliminalmeter.json.startdescription:
Birds of a scale, wings and talons bright
Worms of a feather, kissed again by stones
Kissed by fire, kissed by snow, by blight.

 This is Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.preliminalmeter.json.desc:
Birds of a scale, wings and talons bright
Worms of a feather, kissed again by stones
Kissed by fire, kissed by snow, by blight.

Data:Commit.ith.s.purifications.exaltati.label: The Tree
Data:Commit.ith.s.purifications.exaltati.startdescription: Never underestimate the Hour named Madrugad. Foolish adepts deride her as an Hour of ashes. What do they think the Watchman's Tree sprang from? Fire purifies; light exalts.
Data:Commit.ith.s.purifications.exaltati.desc: Never underestimate the Hour named Madrugad. Foolish adepts deride her as an Hour of ashes. What do they think the Watchman's Tree sprang from?

Data:Commit.ith.s.putrefactions.calcinat.label: In Flames
Data:Commit.ith.s.putrefactions.calcinat.startdescription: All days are death, all lives are sunset. No fire will last without fuel; there can be no Second Dawn without a war to burn the bones of earth. This is Ithastry at its most merciless.
Data:Commit.ith.s.putrefactions.calcinat.desc: All days are death, all lives are sunset. No fire will last without fuel; there can be no Second Dawn without a war to burn the bones of earth.

Data:Commit.ith.s.pyroglyphics.json.label: A Red Blossom
Data:Commit.ith.s.pyroglyphics.json.startdescription: Stories written in fire end all the sooner... but are remembered all the longer. The Ithastry wisdom teaches us the certainty of change.
Data:Commit.ith.s.pyroglyphics.json.desc: Stories written in fire end all the sooner... but are remembered all the longer. Change is the only certainty.

Data:Commit.ith.s.solutions.separations..label: The Straight
Data:Commit.ith.s.solutions.separations..startdescription: The world is all imbalance. With time, with care, with ingenuity, we can restore the balance, through the shaping of stone, the equilibrium of ichors, the unhatching of the egg. Ithastry teaches ingenuity.
Data:Commit.ith.s.solutions.separations..desc: The world is all imbalance. With time, with care, with ingenuity, we can restore the balance, through the shaping of stone, the equilibrium of ichors, the unhatching of the egg.

Data:Commit.ith.s.spices.savours.json.label: Served Hot
Data:Commit.ith.s.spices.savours.json.startdescription: Copper, coal, fire, cinnamon, sunlight, obsidian. Add salt to taste. Serve. That's Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.spices.savours.json.desc: Copper, coal, fire, cinnamon, sunlight, obsidian. Add salt to taste. Serve.

Data:Commit.ith.s.stitching.binding.json.label: To Hold
Data:Commit.ith.s.stitching.binding.json.startdescription: A deft enough binding might contain anything: flesh; spirit; gods; light. That would be Ithastry.
Data:Commit.ith.s.stitching.binding.json.desc: A deft enough binding might contain anything: flesh; spirit; gods; light.

Data:Commit.ith.s.transformations.libera.label: From Steel
Data:Commit.ith.s.transformations.libera.startdescription: If the Sun has failed… then we must manufacture our own Second Dawn, with eye, with hand, with the light beneath the heart. It won't be easy, but what great work ever is? Ithastry might shape the way.
Data:Commit.ith.s.transformations.libera.desc: If the Sun has failed… then we must manufacture our own Second Dawn, with eye, with hand, with the light beneath the heart. It won't be easy, but what great work ever is?

Data:Commit.memory.json.label: The Roots of Memory
Data:Commit.memory.json.startdescription: There are always choices, and so there are always regrets. [Unlock the Tree, and gain a Trist card.]
Data:Commit.memory.json.desc: Here I began my climb. [As you learn Skills, you can decide where in the Tree of Wisdoms they belong - enriching your Soul as you catalogue the invisible world.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.auroralcontemplations..label: The Sunset Road
Data:Commit.nyc.s.auroralcontemplations..startdescription: Each journey is a day, and we are tested as travellers and as pilgrims. That is the part these Contemplations play in the Nyctodromy Wisdom.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.auroralcontemplations..desc: Each journey is a day, and we are tested as travellers and as pilgrims.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.coil.chasm.json.label: Peacock
Data:Commit.nyc.s.coil.chasm.json.startdescription: The Night Arts teach that the Peacock Gate is the highest door in dreams to which mortals may aspire; but that before she rose to this estate, the Gate was a Name of the Horned-Axe. All nyctodromists seek to understand what this might mean.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.coil.chasm.json.desc: The Night Arts teach that the Peacock Gate is the highest door in dreams to which mortals may aspire; but that before she rose to this estate, the Gate was a Name of the Horned-Axe.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.disciplines.thehammer..label: Amber, Orichalcum
Data:Commit.nyc.s.disciplines.thehammer..startdescription: A certain parable of the Night Arts tells of a pilgrim who raised a gate of amber and orichalcum that they might pass to reach their destination; but then found their destination lay on this side of the gate.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.disciplines.thehammer..desc: A certain parable of the Night Arts tells of a pilgrim who raised a gate of amber and orichalcum that they might pass to reach their destination; but then found their destination lay on this side of the gate.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.door.wall.json.label: What May Not Be
Data:Commit.nyc.s.door.wall.json.startdescription: There is a prophecy, of a shining City that mortals might build. There is a paradox, that a City Unbuilt can always be greater than one that exists. The Night Arts teach this resolution: that the gate to that City must be fashioned from black sapphire, and raised in dreams.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.door.wall.json.desc: There is a prophecy, of a shining City that mortals might build. There is a paradox, that a City Unbuilt can always be greater than one that exists. The Night Arts teach this resolution: that the gate to that City must be shaped of black sapphire, and raised in dreams.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.edictsliminal.json.label: Sapphire
Data:Commit.nyc.s.edictsliminal.json.startdescription: There is a prophecy of a glorious City that mortals could raise, but the Hours of the Chancel have decreed that it will not exist. The decrees of the Chancel are not defied, but now and then they have been circumvented… and we might conceive that a City with walls of shining flint could be raised in dreams; in the Mansus. This would be Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.edictsliminal.json.desc: There is a prophecy of a glorious City that mortals could raise, but the Hours of the Chancel have decreed that it will not exist. The decrees of the Chancel are not defied, but now and then they have been circumvented… and we might conceive that a City with walls of shining flint could be raised in dreams; in the Mansus.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.furs.feathers.json.label: The Wings in the Wood
Data:Commit.nyc.s.furs.feathers.json.startdescription: When the first hunters were lost in the Wood, in the days before its darkening, they found a chrysalis of black and white. To it they sacrificed the birds of the air, so that it would show them the way home. So the Moth came to be, and so the Moth was the first to navigate the ways of the Wood. This is the foundation of Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.furs.feathers.json.desc: When the first hunters came to the Wood, in the days before its darkening, they found a chrysalis of black and white. To it they sacrificed the birds of the air, so that it would show them the way home. So the Moth came to be, and so the Moth was the first to navigate the ways of the Wood.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.hyksos.json.label: The Watchmen
Data:Commit.nyc.s.hyksos.json.startdescription: The veterans of the Légion du Seuil, who guard the boundaries of the waking world, tell stories of the labyrinths under the Mansus, above the Wood, and inside the Moon, where the first fallen Hours sleep, or hide, or rot: the gods-from-stone. Why the labyrinths? Because, the legionnaires say, there are Hours ruling now who would fight to consume the last scraps of their old enemies; and those who feast would eclipse those who abstain. The legionnaires have been known to boast that if they were only offered a great enough prize, they could guide the hungry Hours to their feast.

The legionnaires have been known to boast that if they were only offered a great enough prize, they could guide the hungry Hours to their feast.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.insects.nectars.json.label: The Moth's Spawn
Data:Commit.nyc.s.insects.nectars.json.startdescription: The bright-winged, dark-winged Glaeterfleoge-kind called themselves the Moth's spawn. They are gone now, like all the Carapace-kinds, but we can still use the arts of the Nest to follow the old roads of the night; the legacy of the Carapace Cross; Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.insects.nectars.json.desc: The bright-winged, dark-winged Glaeterfleoge-kind called themselves the Moth's spawn. They are gone now, like all the Carapace-kinds, but we can still use the arts of the Nest to follow the old roads of the night; the legacy of the Carapace Cross.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.path.pilgrim.json.label: The Path
Data:Commit.nyc.s.path.pilgrim.json.startdescription: Speech is the key to dream, and because we are speaking apes, every night is a journey. Nyctodromy is the wisdom of the paths of night.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.path.pilgrim.json.desc: Speech is the key to dream, and because we are speaking apes, every night is a journey.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.pearl.tide.json.label: What Remains
Data:Commit.nyc.s.pearl.tide.json.startdescription: The Sea: whale-road, salt-realm, moon-way. Anything given to the waves may find another home - unless its home is the Sea. Nyctodromy shows us the way across the sea, and the way home.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.pearl.tide.json.desc: The Sea: whale-road, salt-realm, moon-way. Anything given to the waves may find another home - unless its home is the Sea.
